description: Returns the current state of two-factor authentication: `preferred_method` (active second factor, may be `null`) and `allowed_methods` (which methods are selectable). Allowed values: `email` (always), `totp` (when TOTP is configured), `telegram` (when a Telegram chat is linked), `max` (when a MAX chat is linked).
name: two_factor_info
title: Get 2FA info
